title: Tick Stock Panel brings LLM-assisted analysis to a self-hosted trading workbench
friendlyTitle: Tick Stock Panel is a self-hosted workspace for market research
summary: Tick Stock Panel is a trending, MIT-licensed Python and TypeScript workbench for Chinese A-share screening, monitoring, backtesting and paper trading. It has about 5,200 stars, active development and features for connecting language models to strategy customization, stock analysis and review.
friendlySummary: This popular open-source project combines Chinese stock screening, monitoring, backtesting and practice trading. It can connect AI models to help customize and review analysis.
whyItMatters: Quantitative hobbyists and developers can self-host it to study an end-to-end research workflow and extend data sources or analysis modules. Treat model-generated market analysis as exploratory input rather than financial advice, and validate strategies against realistic costs and out-of-sample data.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Use it to study or build a private market-research workflow. Test every strategy carefully and do not treat an AI-generated view as financial advice.
